props.covers: Feedback edges use direct labels, flow-facing endpoint steering, and clear return corridors; the ROUTES block and edge-related diagnostics judge the production-routed result.

props.title: Feedback uses a clear return corridor

text.insert: A feedback edge exits toward a clear return corridor, carries its meaning on the edge label, and routes without crossing boxes, merging with another run, or reading as a section border.

together define the mechanism: label edges directly, enter and exit on faces that point along the flow, reserve air for the return, and keep two runs from sharing a line. The router chooses sides when steering is omitted. When the route needs help, steer minimally in order — anchor, then endpoint position, then waypoints — and read the returned ROUTES polyline and through list before judging it done. Enforcement is measured on that production-routed polyline by

: a route through a non-endpoint box is an error that blocks a committed finalize, while shared runs, border hugging, stranded chips, and excessive crossings are warnings that must be fixed or explicitly overridden.

separately catches a label chip covering a box, chip, or foreign routed wire. unreadable-labels checks whether a chip fits between its endpoints, and crowding warns when sibling gaps do not leave the minimum arrow corridor. Fixable findings carry ready-to-send

Verification: add connections after section content is in place, then judge the returned ROUTES block and pushed render. A clean return has an empty through list, a readable direct label, and a path that owns its corridor.
